fields.name: items
fields.coerce: `Number.isInteger` on each entry, with no conversion. The string `"3"` fails with `no_item`
fields.description: The slots of the three items: the same item name at the same level, three different slots. The result goes to the first slot.

fields.name: scroll_num
fields.coerce: none: used as an array key, so `"10"` also works. Any other value reads an empty slot
fields.description: The slot of a compound scroll (`cscroll0` to `cscroll3`).

fields.name: offering_num
fields.coerce: none: used as an array key
fields.description: The slot of an item of type `offering`. An empty slot counts as no offering, with no error.

fields.name: clevel
fields.coerce: compared with `!=` to `items[0].level || 0`, so `"2"` also matches 2
fields.description: The level of the items now. If it does not match, the compound fails with `no_item`. It is required also at level 0.

fields.name: calculate
fields.description: Any true value: the server only sends the chance (the variant Calculate). It consumes nothing and starts no timer. Absent or false: the compound starts (the variant Compound).

list.name: Compound
list.when: Starts the compound: the server removes the scroll, the offering and the items, and starts a timer. The result comes when the timer ends.

fields.name: calculate
fields.description: Absent or a false value.

responses.name: Started
responses.when: All checks pass. There is no `game_response` now.
responses.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`. The server removed the scroll and the offering. `items[items[0]]` is a `PlaceholderItem`, the other two slots are `null`, and `q.compound` is `{ms, len, num, nums: []}` (a `QueueEntry` with an empty `nums`).

responses.name: Progress
responses.when: During the timer: when the time left goes below 8,000, 6,400, 5,000 and 3,000 ms, the server shows one more digit of the roll; below 2,200 ms it sets `p.success` or `p.failure`. These limits do not scale with `len`, so a short timer (`hardcore`, `massproduction`) shows several digits in the first update.

fields.name: q
fields.description: All your timers (`player.q`). `q.compound` also has `nums: []`.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The slot of the placeholder.

fields.name: p
fields.description: The placeholder state, with the digits so far.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: The timer ends and the roll succeeds. The first slot gets the item at the new level.

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code.

fields.name: level
fields.description: The new level of the item.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The slot of the item: `items[0]` from the request.

fields.name: up
fields.description: Only for a `booster` with an offering: the extra levels that the server added (each with a chance of 12%, then half of that, and so on).

fields.name: stale
fields.description: You left the game while the timer ran (the queue survived the logout, node/server_functions.js:4512).

responses.name: Fail
responses.when: The timer ends and the roll fails. The three items are gone, and the first slot is `null`.

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code.

fields.name: level
fields.description: The level of the items before the compound.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The slot: `items[0]` from the request.

fields.name: stale
fields.description: You left the game while the timer ran (the queue survived the logout, node/server_functions.js:4512).

also.when: The timer ends. Every client whose view holds the compound NPC on `main`.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The kind of result.

fields.name: success
fields.description: 1 for a success, 0 for a failure.

also.when: The timer ends: a success for an item worth more than 1,800,000 gold, or a failure for an item worth more than 920,000 gold. Each limit uses `calculate_item_value(item) + edge * 2,000,000`. Not when you are `stealth`.
The timer ends. It carries the result code above as `hitchhikers`, with `reopen: true`.
also.summary: Your state with the result item (or `null`) in the slot.

order: during the timer: `q_data` to you, up to 5 times
at the end: `server_message` to everyone for an expensive item, then `upgrade` to clients near the NPC
then `player` to you. Its `hitchhikers` hold `compound_success` or `compound_fail`

list.name: Calculate
list.when: Sends the chance of success only. Nothing changes.

fields.name: response

fields.name: place
fields.description: The request.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Always `true`.

fields.name: calculate
fields.description: Always `true`.

fields.name: chance
fields.description: The chance of success, 0 to 1. A `booster` gives 0.9999999999999.

fields.name: item

fields.name: scroll

fields.name: offering

fields.name: grace

confirm.note: `offering: undefined` drops out of the JSON when there is no offering

failures.intro: **Server bug:** some failures send a bare string, not an object. The handler runs inside `try`; an error sends `exception`.

rows.when: `items` is not an array of 3 entries. A `null` payload also ends here, with `exception`.
An entry of `items` is not an integer.
No character. The handler reads `player.items` before it checks `player`, and the error goes to the `catch`.
The character is in the bank.
`offering_num` holds an item that is not of type `offering`.
The slot `scroll_num` is empty. The server checks this before the three items.
A slot of `items` is empty (also a negative or too large index).
You are more than `B.sell_dist` (400 px) from the compound NPC on `main`. A character with a `computer` passes this check.
rows.note: the form of a failure, sent by `socket.emit`

rows.when: The first item is at grade 4.
rows.note: the form of a failure, sent by `socket.emit`

rows.when: The three items do not have the same name and level.
`clevel` is not the level of the items.
The scroll is not a `cscroll`, or its grade is below the grade of the item.
Two entries of `items` are the same slot.

rows.when: One of the three items has the lock `l`.
rows.note: the form of a failure, sent by `socket.emit`
